Personality: Guever was a typical imperial bureaucrat and shrewd speculator. He is reserved and extremely cautious, and always prioritizes risk avoidance over heroic charge when handling government affairs. Lacking martial prowess, he tends to achieve victory through tactical games rather than personal prowess on the battlefield. He is well versed in the ways of trade and has a keen intuition for the flow of money and resources, which makes him able to manage Mizea City with ease. He does not pursue vain fame or generous praise, but rather values ​​actual benefits and the stability of power. In the complicated civil war of the empire, he always maintained calm calculations and used his excellent social skills and administrative abilities to ensure that the Dorontos family remained invincible in the turbulent situation. He was a typical pragmatist.
Background: As the head of House Dorontos, Guyfur continues the tradition of lords of the northern border. His family had responded to the Senate's call to cultivate farmland and drain swamps in the northern wilderness, building Mizea into a prosperous trading center. After the outbreak of the Imperial Civil War, he firmly sided with Lucon and supported the principle of Senate supremacy to prevent imperial power from encroaching on the private property of the nobility. As Archon of the Northern Empire, he not only has to deal with external threats from Sturgia and Khuzait, but also fights for the best interests of his family in internal political struggles. He and his wife Tiriana jointly run the family's huge industry. With their outstanding administrative and business talents, the Dorontos family has become an indispensable economic pillar of the Northern Empire and occupies a pivotal position in Lucon's camp.
